suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require SLE and separately established incident atrial fibrillation; do not generalize the source to every arrhythmia phenotype. Meta-analysis supports incident AF association with substantial heterogeneity; no individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) and Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus

suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment associated risk. Require SLE plus corticosteroid/immunosuppressive treatment and documented TB infection/reactivation/disease; evaluate epidemiologic exposure and baseline latent TB status. Treatment/immunosuppression-associated pathway; SLE alone should not be represented as a sufficient cause. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment or procedure used for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
Independent diagnosis of Mycobacterium Tuberculosis and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and source-phenotype fit
